title: Great Experience
text: José Miguel gave us an incredible experience in Seville. He was extremely knowledgeable and showed us some of the city’s most remarkable sights. His communication was excellent—he answered all of our questions with ease and even made extra stops based on our group’s requests. We highly recommend working with José Miguel.
author: alisab802

title: The best tour of my entire vacation!!!
text: Seville is beyond beautiful, and HOT.   Dress lightly, drink plenty of water.  Also, you need ID to enter the catedral, and your shoulders must be covered.  Bring a scarf (they also sell you one at the catedral should you forget).
author: Lorena_M

title: SierraSea – Your Gateway to Coastal Adventures in Lagos
text:
My husband and I did the Seville from Algarve Tour while staying in Lagos. I had no idea Seville was only about 2 hours away by car! Our guide was extremely friendly and trustworthy, and he picked us up directly from our hotel.
The tour itself was fantastic, we visited the Cathedral and La Giralda tower, as well as the Royal Palace Alcázar. For lunch, we had delicious Spanish tapas at a wonderful restaurant our guide recommended.

title: Visiting to Seville from Lagos
